intro: Agent ek LLM ke around loop hai: socho, tool chuno, result dekho, phir agla step. Is section me tool registry, action parsing, deterministic loop, retries, guardrails aur step logging pure Python me banaye jate hain — frameworks inhi patterns ko package karte hain.
theory: Tool ek function hai jiska naam, description aur input schema hota hai. Model description padhkar tool chunta hai, isliye description hi contract hai.
Agent loop typically: model se action lo, tool chalao, observation wapas prompt me do, repeat — max steps ke saath, warna infinite loop.
Actions ko structured format me parse karo (JSON/function call). Free text parse karna brittle hai, isliye validation aur fallback zaroori hai.
Guardrails: allowed tools ki list, destructive actions se pehle confirmation, input validation aur step/time budget.
Observability ke bina agent debug nahi hota: har step ka input, tool, output aur latency log karo. Retries sirf transient failures par karo.
syntax:
for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
    action = model.decide(state)
    observation = run_tool(action)
    state["history"].append((action, observation))

explain: Allowlist destructive ya unknown tools ko block karti hai.
Output ko print se verify karo.
Ye Agentic AI + LangChain + n8n ka basic building block hai.

Ek step aur jodne se behaviour kaise badalta hai, dekho.

examples.code:
import json

TOOLS = {
    'lookup_customer': lambda cid: {'id': cid, 'name': 'Asha'},
    'open_ticket': lambda cid, issue: f'ticket-{cid}-{issue[:4]}',
}

plan = [
    {'tool': 'lookup_customer', 'args': {'cid': 7}},
    {'tool': 'open_ticket', 'args': {'cid': 7, 'issue': 'refund delay'}},
]

history = []
for step in plan:
    action = json.loads(json.dumps(step))
    if action['tool'] not in TOOLS:
        history.append(('blocked', action['tool']))
        continue
    observation = TOOLS[action['tool']](**action['args'])
    history.append((action['tool'], observation))

print(history)
print('steps used:', len(history), '/', len(plan))
explain: Tool allowlist, dispatch aur step history — ek chhota auditable agent loop.

realWorld: Support agents tool se order status/refund status dekhte hain; destructive refund action se pehle human approval rakhi jati hai.
n8n/LangChain workflows me retries aur idempotency keys duplicate side effects rokhte hain.
Agent cost tokens aur tool calls se badhta hai, isliye step budget aur caching production me mandatory hain.

interview.q: Agent aur simple LLM call me fark kya hai?
interview.a: Simple call ek prompt ka ek response hai. Agent loop me model tool chunta hai, result dekhta hai aur agla step decide karta hai — isliye state, budget aur guardrails chahiye.

interview.q: Agent ko infinite loop se kaise rokte hain?
interview.a: Max steps, per-tool timeout, cost/token budget aur repeated action detection. Loop ke har iteration par budget check hona chahiye.

interview.q: Tool description itni important kyun hai?
interview.a: Model description ke basis par tool select karta hai. Ambiguous description galat tool chunwa deti hai; clear input schema aur examples selection accuracy badhate hain.

interview.q: Destructive tool ke liye kya pattern use karoge?
interview.a: Human-in-the-loop approval, dry-run mode, allowlist aur idempotency key. Agent ko direct delete/refund permission nahi deni chahiye.

debugging.why: String immutable hai; append list ka method hai. Ye Agentic AI + LangChain + n8n ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: String concatenation ya join use karo.
debugging.lesson: AttributeError galat type par method call ka signal hai.

debugging.why: Naam ki spelling galat hai; Python namespace me wo naam nahi milta. Ye Agentic AI + LangChain + n8n ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: NameError typo ya missing assignment batata hai.

debugging.error: Logic error — sort() None return karta hai, list print nahi hoti
debugging.why: sort() in-place hai aur None deta hai, isliye print None dikhata hai. Ye Agentic AI + LangChain + n8n ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: sorted() use karo ya pehle sort phir list print karo.
debugging.lesson: Mutating methods ka return value None hota hai — usse assign/print mat karo.

debugging.broken:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total = p
print(total)
debugging.error: Logic error — total 200 aata hai, sum 300 hona chahiye
debugging.why: Assignment purani value replace karta hai; accumulator chahiye. Ye Agentic AI + LangChain + n8n ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: total += p use karo ya sum(prices).
debugging.correct:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total += p
print(total)
debugging.lesson: Logic bugs exception nahi dete — chhote sample par expected value likho.
